s: the tiny Sienna Street stall that's sold the same zapiekanka since Communist-era Poland
w: A cash-only, closet-sized stall off the Main Square that has toasted the same open-faced mushroom-and-cheese baguette since 1980 -- opened as the regime was crumbling, when eating one here doubled as a small act of defiance. Same recipe, same ladies running it, decades on. Cheap, unpretentious, and the benchmark by which Kraków locals judge every other zapiekanka in the city.
_facts: Located at ul. Sienna 3, 31-041 Kraków, near the Main Market Square
Trading continuously since 1980, opened by Marta as Communist Poland's regime was ending
Considered one of the original, longest-running zapiekanka stalls in Kraków
